confirmation.source: User Plague Queen request and explicit confirmation: two 60-damage poison ticks at 1.25 and 2.5 seconds after impact.

mechanicNotes: Plague Queen: 2 Aether, 170 HP, one ground troop, 1.25 tiles/s movement, 20-tile attack range and circular 20-tile enemy awareness. Targets ground troops, air troops and structures.
Fires one poison arrow every 2.7 seconds at 30 tiles/s. Only the direct target takes 212 immediate damage.

At impact, enemies within 6 tiles receive poison: 60 damage at 1.25 seconds and 60 at 2.5 seconds. The direct target also receives poison if alive. Maximum exposure is 332 on the direct target and 120 on other splash victims, before mitigation and HP limits.

Poison follows each affected enemy after it leaves the splash area; entering the old impact area later does not apply poison. Separate arrows carry separate two-tick applications. Poison continues if its Queen dies and remains credited to her deployment.
Plague Queen has a detailed green slime-queen model, fitted crown and bow, model-rendered card portrait, poison arrows, spreading impact splashes and animated toxic bubbles.
All existing card stats, arena geometry, models and audio retain their 2.1.0 values. Existing card awareness retains its previous behavior.
